note: Territory index. To add a nation: add its data file under public/data/web/territories/ and one entry here. No code change needed. Colors: Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette, one per nation.

nations.name: Chickasaw
nations.note: Extent shown is the 1786 Treaty of Hopewell frame; its southern edge is not fixed by the sources.
nations.mapNote: General area (1786 Hopewell frame): approximate, not a boundary.

nations.name: Cherokee
nations.mapNote: General area: Kentucky part of the 1771 cession and Chickamauga counties. Approximate, low-medium confidence, not a boundary. Treaty lines dashed outside Kentucky.
nations.note: Main-map shape = sourced treaty/survey lines (1768, 1770, 1771) plus the Chickamauga county footprint. Pre-1768 Kentucky use has no dated boundary and is not drawn.

nations.name: Shawnee
nations.mapNote: Presence in Kentucky c.1735–c.1782; claim to most of Kentucky asserted by 1768 (whole-state outline = most generous estimate, not a boundary). Ohio town counties and the 1774 Ohio River line run to 1795. Approximate, low-medium confidence.
nations.note: Main-map shape = claim area (Kentucky outline, most generous estimate of “most of Kentucky”; not a boundary), the 1774 Ohio River line and the Ohio town counties. No boundary is sourced.

nations.name: Six Nations (Haudenosaunee)
nations.mapNote: General area associated with the Six Nations (hatched): Kentucky east of the Tennessee River, clipped to Kentucky. A claim by treaty cession, not where people lived; approximate, low-medium confidence, not a boundary. Ohio River solid in Kentucky, dashed beyond.
nations.note: Kentucky east of the Tennessee River was sold to the Crown at Fort Stanwix 1768 on a Six Nations conquest claim that the Cherokee and Shawnee disputed. Outside Kentucky only the dashed Ohio River is drawn.

nations.name: Mingo
nations.mapNote: Presence, no mapped boundary. Three approximate points (Mingo Town OH 1770, Yellow Creek 1774, McClelland’s Station raid 1776). Kentucky camp sites unknown, not drawn.
nations.note: Presence only: sourced towns and raid sites; no Kentucky camp areas are known or drawn.

nations.name: Wyandot
nations.mapNote: Towns at Sandusky and Detroit north of the Ohio, and raid sites in Kentucky (1780, 1782). Approximate area (dashed Ohio county outline), not a boundary. No Kentucky camp sites are known or drawn.
nations.note: Presence only: sourced towns and raid sites; no Kentucky camp areas are known or drawn.

nations.name: Delaware (Lenape)
nations.mapNote: 1804 cession shown as ten Indiana counties (approximate area, not a boundary), plus Bird’s 1780 route and event points. Kentucky camp sites are unknown and not drawn.
nations.note: Ohio and Indiana: towns, the 1780 route, treaty lines and the 1804 cession. No Kentucky camp areas are drawn.

nations.name: Miami (with Wea and Piankashaw)
nations.mapNote: Wabash towns (Miami, Wea, Piankashaw) and the 1804 cession as ten Indiana counties (approximate area, not a boundary). Northern Kentucky hunting ground: no area drawn.
nations.note: Wabash villages and the 1804 cession in southern Indiana; Kentucky hunting is described in text only.

nations.name: Kickapoo (with Mascouten)
nations.mapNote: General area (three counties in Indiana and Illinois), approximate and low confidence; not a boundary. The Mascouten have no area of their own and are shown here. No Kentucky villages are documented.
nations.note: Presence only: a general area in Indiana and Illinois; no Kentucky villages are documented.

nations.name: Illinois Confederation (Kaskaskia, Cahokia)
nations.mapNote: Cahokia and Kaskaskia points, and two river reaches of the 1803 claim (dashed, never closed). Inland calls of the claim are not drawn. Approximate, low–medium confidence.
nations.note: Two town points and the two sourced river reaches of the 1803 claim; no area is drawn.

nations.name: Potawatomi
nations.mapNote: Detroit and Chicago points only. The Great Lakes homeland is outside the map window and is described in text, not drawn. Low confidence.
nations.note: Presence only: two sourced points; the homeland is text only.

nations.name: Ojibwe (Chippewa) and Odawa
nations.mapNote: Bird’s 1780 route only (solid in Kentucky, dashed outside) with Detroit and Martin’s Station points. The homeland is not drawn. The Odawa story about Egushawa is separate.
nations.note: Event route only: Bird’s June 1780 war road; no homeland is drawn.
